org_ref.name: GE Vernova, Inc.
org_ref.mission: Our urgent and optimistic mission is to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We aim to accelerate the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, powering economies and delivering electricity vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life.
org_ref.description: GE Vernova is a global energy company focused on electrifying and decarbonizing the world. It includes Power, Electrification, and Wind segments, with approximately 85,000 employees across 100+ countries. The company's technology helps generate about 25% of the world's electricity, aiming to deliver a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.
